summary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment to limit any person from being elected President more than three times, or more than twice if they served more than two years of another President's term.

scores.thoughts: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment to limit the number of times a person can be elected President, specifically to no more than three times, and sets limits for those who have already served. This directly impacts the rules governing presidential elections and eligibility, making it central to the topic of voting and elections.
